note.en: A turrid (turret snail) of the Caribbean. Here it is known only from one 1945 museum specimen from Limón and is rarely noticed alive.
note.es: Un turrido (caracol torre) del Caribe. Aquí solo se conoce por un ejemplar de museo de 1945 de Limón y rara vez se nota vivo.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
